items.source: Annotation at the field or method/constructor parameter level that injects the HTTP server port that was allocated at runtime. Provides a convenient alternative for @Value("${local.server.port}") with the assumption that the web server implementation has configured such a property.
items.translation: 在字段或方法/构造函数参数级别注入运行时分配的 HTTP 服务器端口的注解。它提供了使用 @Value("${local.server.port}") 的便捷替代方案，前提是 Web 服务器实现已配置了该属性。
